hints.title: Ternary Slot Representation
hints.text: Each slot can hold up to 2 numbers, represented as a state with values 0, 1, or 2 for each slot.

hints.title: Base 3 Mask
hints.text: Represent the distribution of numbers into slots using a base 3 integer mask (at most 3^9 = 19,683 states).

hints.title: Dynamic Programming Transition
hints.text: The count of allocated numbers equals the sum of slot counts in the mask, allowing direct DP over the sequence of numbers.

hints.title: Complete Python Solution

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing permutations of assigning 18 numbers into 9 slots of capacity 2 yields 9^18 combinations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Base 3 mask compresses slot capacities to 3^9 = 19683 states.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Model multi-capacity slots using base-3 ternary states.

solutions.approach: C++ iterative base-3 knapsack-style dynamic programming.
